name: Ashe
source:
Strengths - Unshakable morality, medicinal knowledge, clothing design 
Weaknesses - Overprotective, afraid of losing his loved ones

Ashe runs a small tailoring establishment in Sid Caeham called “The Primrose”, where he spends his days with his head buried in craft.

He adores his daughter Prim, who he adopted from the orphanage he ran with his wife before she passed away. He has a habit of wanting to look after others - as can be seen in the cases of Illran and Cyne.

[From the developer's [url=https://twitter.com/TwoHalfStudios/status/1287198901737406464/]official Twitter [/url]]
